newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to announce Q1 GNP on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to announce Q1 GNP on Thursday.

text.p: Philippines Planning Minister Cielito Habito has called a press conference on Thursday to announce first quarter gross national product figures, the National Economic and Development Authority (Neda) said on Wednesday.
The press conference is set for 10:00 a.m. (0200 GMT).
Habito has said that first quarter GNP "will be around the same vicinity" as the 6.6 percent level the first quarter last year.
